decisions.statement: A category is reached by its page's slug rather than by Monarch's own id.
A slug that names no existing category is refused.
A merged or renamed category is loud.
A category page with no Monarch id is refused.
A category named in words resolves only where exactly one page has that title.
An amount sign is positive or negative or nothing.
A value coming before any flag that value could belong to is refused rather than guessed at.
A flag may be given several times and has every value given.

definition: the category pages a rule names, and the flags a rule tool is called with
